scene_sentence_zh: 光裸的山頂環立著蝕痕斑駁的巨石，低垂的日光把石影拉過短草與碎石。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a ring of tall standing stones carved with abstract worn spiral grooves on a bare hilltop, one slab leaning out of true, frost in the lichen-crusted joints, the sun low behind the stones and casting long shadows over short turf, loose pebbles and an open worn approach leading into the circle

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG hilltop stone circle of tall slabs carved with abstract concentric spiral grooves, one slab leaning out of true, frosted lichen in the joints, long hard shadows over short turf and a worn approach of stepping stones. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the stones occupy the upper two thirds over open turf.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the standing stones and carvings keep the upper band while the open turf and approach stay clear below.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
